subject: Recap + Proposed 3-week PoV for conversational search pilot
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@evermind.ai>; Tom Harris <tom.harris@evermind.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 24 Jan 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + Proposed 3-week PoV for conversational search pilot

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier — really valuable to see the search flows and the three core use cases you want to validate (document search for agents, topical summarization for supervisors, and a conversational assistant for IA routing). Per our conversation I put together a concise PoV proposal and success criteria attached (redwood_pov-outline.pdf). Key items in this note:

- High-level goals: reduce agent time-to-answer by 30%, achieve >85% relevance on top-3 results for sampled queries, and keep 95th percentile query latency under 250ms for typical 1–3k token context.
- Proposed length: 3 weeks (short, focused), with milestones and owners.
- Required inputs from your side: 1) sample corpus export (CSV/JSON), 2) 25–50 representative queries with expected relevance labels, 3) SRE/security contact for the test account and network allowlist, and 4) point of contact for UAT.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Confirm the three success criteria above (metrics or tweak if needed)
2) Kickoff call next week (30–45 min) to confirm data transfer method and test account details
3) I’ll send the PoV SOW / mutual action plan and spin up a sandbox project with trial credits once we have kickoff scheduled.

Attachment: redwood_pov-outline.pdf (3-page plan)
Attachment: sample-mmp.csv (small sample mapping file)

If you’re good with that, can you confirm availability for a kickoff on Monday (1/26) or Tuesday (1/27) morning PT?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Elena Ruiz <elena@evermind.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Harris <tom.harris@evermind.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Jan 2027 09:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Recap + Proposed 3-week PoV for conversational search pilot

Hi Chloe —

Thanks for the clear recap and the doc — I reviewed the attached PoV outline with Tom and our Head of Support (Ana). The three success criteria look reasonable, but two small asks:

1) For relevance, can we validate both precision@3 and qualitative agent satisfaction (short survey for 10 agents)? We find a hybrid metric helps surface edge cases.
2) For latency, 250ms at 95th percentile is acceptable for our staging traffic, but we’ll need a runbook for graceful degradation if the 95th spikes during peak hours.

Security note: Our security team will need a short questionnaire about data residency and retention — we generally do not want customer content retained longer than 30 days in non-prod. Can you point me to a SOC2 / data-retention policy and an on-prem or VPC option summary?

We can do a kickoff Monday 1/26 at 10:00 PT. Tom and I will join; Ana (security) will try to join for the first 15 minutes.

Elena Ruiz
Director, Product Ops | Evermind
elena@evermind.ai
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@evermind.ai>, Tom Harris <tom.harris@evermind.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Jan 2027 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + Proposed 3-week PoV for conversational search pilot

Elena — great notes, appreciate the specificity. Quick answers and an updated plan below.

Relevance metrics
- Agreed: we’ll measure precision@3 (automated) and run a short agent satisfaction survey (5-question, 10 agents) the final week. We’ll collect both and include qualitative notes.

Latency / runbook
- We’ll instrument a simple fallback policy: if 95th exceeds 350ms for more than a 5-minute window we automatically route queries to a lower-context (128-token) fast path and surface a brief notice to agents. Marcus will own the fallback config and test it during week 2.

Data residency / retention / security
- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II certified; I’ve attached the SOC2 summary and a 1-page note describing retention controls and our VPC/private deployment options. Non-prod projects created for PoVs are set to 30-day max retention by default; we can shorten that on request.

Updated PoV timeline (3 weeks) 
- Week 0 (prep, 2–3 business days): data ingest + mapping, account setup, allowlist + credentials (owner: Evermind SRE; SE support: Marcus)
- Week 1 (integration & baseline): model selection, embeddings index, baseline run vs your sample queries (owner: Marcus + Evermind data lead)
- Week 2 (iteration & gating): relevance tuning, AB runs for top-3 ranking, latency/load test, run fallback test (owner: Marcus + Redwood infra)
- Week 3 (UAT & acceptance): agent survey, decision review, handoff recommendations (owner: Elena + Chloe)

Owners & contacts
- Redwood AE: Chloe Martin (coordination, success criteria)
- Redwood SE: Marcus Lin (integration, tuning, load tests)
- Redwood Sales Ops: Ben Carter (trial credits / billing questions)
- Evermind SRE: TBD (allowlist / data transfer)
- Evermind product lead: Elena Ruiz (final acceptance)

Deliverables
- Baseline relevance report (precision@1/3), latency percentiles, tuning notes
- Short runbook for fallback behavior and observed thresholds
- Final decision checklist + agent survey results

Attachments included: redwood_pov-outline.pdf, SOC2-summary.pdf, short-retention-vpc-options.pdf

Next steps for kickoff Monday 1/26 10:00 PT:
1) Please confirm the SRE contact (email) and preferred data transfer method (SFTP / secure Share / AWS S3 presigned).
2) I’ll create the sandbox project and push the HubSpot deal link + mutual action plan — Ben will add trial credits once the MAP is signed.

Tom / Ben / Marcus — I’ll loop you into the kickoff invite. Marcus, can you prepare a short checklist of what you’ll need from Evermind for data schema and sample queries?

Thanks — see you Monday.

Best,
Chloe

--
Attachments: SOC2-summary.pdf; short-retention-vpc-options.pdf
